say: Your laptop is across the room. Your phone is in your hand.
caption: Your laptop is across the room. Your phone is in your hand.

say: Edgepad turns it into the laptop's trackpad, remote and control panel.
caption: Edgepad turns it into the laptop's trackpad, remote and control panel.

say: Pair them once over Bluetooth. No account, no Why-Fye, no cloud.
caption: Pair them once over Bluetooth. No account, no Wi-Fi, no cloud.

say: The whole screen is a trackpad. Tap to click, two fingers to scroll, pinch to zoom.
caption: The whole screen is a trackpad. Tap to click, two fingers to scroll, pinch to zoom.

say: The edges are dials. Slide along a corner to change the volume or the brightness.
caption: The edges are dials. Slide along a corner to change the volume or the brightness.

say: Split a corner in two, and you get up to eight.
caption: Split a corner in two, and you get up to eight.

say: Whatever is playing shows on the surface, with play, pause and skip.
caption: Whatever is playing shows on the surface, with play, pause and skip.

say: Your macros sit in a deck. Drag to reorder them, pick the grid, and tap to open an app, a file or a website.
caption: Your macros sit in a deck. Drag to reorder them, pick the grid, and tap to open an app, a file or a website.

say: A full keyboard, with modifier keys for shortcuts.
caption: A full keyboard, with modifier keys for shortcuts.

say: Annotate turns the phone into a pen on the laptop's screen, and Sign saves your signature as an image.
caption: Annotate turns the phone into a pen on the laptop's screen, and Sign saves your signature as an image.

say: Capture takes a screenshot or a recording, using the laptop's own tool.
caption: Capture takes a screenshot or a recording, using the laptop's own tool.

say: And a gamepad, for games on Windows and Linux.
caption: And a gamepad, for games on Windows and Linux.

say: Choose how much a phone is trusted: a yes once, a six-digit P I N the first time, or the P I N every time.
caption: Choose how much a phone is trusted: a yes once, a six-digit PIN the first time, or the PIN every time.

say: Light or dark, upright or sideways.
caption: Light or dark, upright or sideways.

say: It works with Windows, and now with Mac and Linux, which are still in testing.
caption: It works with Windows, and now with Mac and Linux, which are still in testing.

say: Edgepad is free and open source. Find it on Git-Hub.
caption: Edgepad is free and open source. Find it on GitHub.
